scope: Six everyday interiors plus a distinct complete interior for every Hong Kong and existing international room-calendar occasion.
requirements: Brand-new architecture, style and furniture layout for each room
Navigation, work stations and entrances match each delivered painting

Holiday selection overrides ordinary daily rotation; manual choices remain available
